important_corrections: Do not count relocation of the same admission rule as a separate new mechanism.
iDMA AR is virtual, not physical completion AR.
AR to first R mixes translation and memory delay.
PTW active or ARVALID is not a leaf-soon signal.
Changing address with the same modeled DDR path does not separate the queue.
4KiB fullbuffer certificate already exempts owner read admission when DID matches.
Changing AXI burst length while keeping 4KiB job need not revoke certificate; changing job length does.
Gating N accept must account for REJECT lifecycle; existing OUT must drain.
Fast count may fall after a shorter walk; fast count alone neither proves nor disproves benefit.
Ordinary method can be engineering-effective even if PN-P gap does not shrink; not a generic publication acceptance criterion.
